Suppose $(x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ is a nonincreasing sequence of positive real
numbers, and for all $N$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^N \frac{x_{i^2}}{i} \le 1.$$

Show that for all $k$,

$$\sum_{i=1}^k \frac{x_i}{i} \le 3.$$

open Finset

theorem rmo_2000_3
  (x : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
  (hmono : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1))
  (hsq : ∀ N, (Ico 1 (N + 1)).sum (fun i => x (i * i) / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
  intro k
  have h_main : (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
    -- Group terms by intervals [j², (j+1)²)
    have h_sum_bound : (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
      -- For each j, the sum over [j², min(k+1, (j+1)²)) is bounded
      -- by x_{j²}/j times the number of terms, which is at most 2j+1
      -- But we can do better using the harmonic series bound
      calc
        (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) 
          ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, if j = 0 then 0 else 
            (∑ i in (Ico (j * j) (min (k + 1) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)))), x i / (i : ℝ)) := by sorry
        _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, if j = 0 then 0 else 
            x (j * j) / (j : ℝ) * (∑ i in (Ico (j * j) (min (k + 1) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)))), 1 / (i : ℝ)) := by sorry
        _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, if j = 0 then 0 else 
            x (j * j) / (j : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) := by sorry
        _ = 2 * ∑' j : ℕ, if j = 0 then 0 else x (j * j) / (j : ℝ) := by sorry
        _ ≤ 2 * 1 := by sorry
        _ ≤ 3 := by sorry
    exact h_sum_bound
  exact h_main
